_comment: Hourly weather states and the tunables of the automatic ("auto") weather of docs/CLIMATE_CALENDAR_WEATHER_ROADMAP.md sections 7, 8, 12 and 16. Each mirrored 1990s day gets a deterministic plan of one state per hour; the server blends each hour into the next across the hour and eases precipitation, thunder, wetness and snow toward what the plan asks, so nothing jumps. Ramps and the soak-to-dry ratio follow GTA San Andreas (REA report section 11), converted from its 60x game clock to Marburgum's real-time one. Provisional values, to be tuned by eye and playtest.

days._comment: How a day's plan is drawn from the month's normals. wet_persistence is the chance a day copies the previous day's wet/dry draw (keeps the monthly frequency, adds multi-day spells). A rain day has 1-3 spells of 2-6 h; its intensity comes from the month's mm per precipitation day. A thunder day (a share of the wet days, from thunder_days) builds cloud for 2 h before a 1-3 h storm starting 13-18 h. A fog day (dry days only, from fog_days) has fog from 03:00 until 1-3 h after sunrise, then an hour of mist.

dynamics._comment: Minutes of real time (the world clock is 1:1). GTA SA ramps rain over ~4 game minutes, soaks roads in ~15 and dries them in ~60; drying here also scales with temperature, wind and sun, per roadmap section 12.
